create_track_head: create a TrackHead module that processes vision transformer tokens and predicts point trajectories
build_track_head_with_dpt: build a TrackHead with DPT feature extractor and BaseTrackerPredictor for iterative point tracking
run_track_head_forward: run the TrackHead forward pass to get predicted coordinates, visibility scores, and confidence scores
test_track_head_iterations: test the TrackHead with configurable refinement iterations and optional query points
review_track_head_config: review the TrackHead configuration including correlation pyramid levels, search radius, and hidden size
